title: Which monsoon brings Mumbai's and Chennai's peak rain?
description: Mumbai's peak rain comes in July and Chennai's in November. The video matches each month with the spell of the south west or the north east monsoon, and breaks Keeko's doubt that both peaks come from one monsoon.
teaching_notes: One idea: the month of the peak and the coast tell which monsoon brought it. Watch for students who give one monsoon for both cities.

source: Mumbai's rain peaks in July and Chennai's in November. Which
video_script.why: The child can read the peak months of a city but has not yet linked a peak to the monsoon that brings it.
video_script.substitution: Match the peak month with the spell of each monsoon, and check which coast the city is on.
video_script.anchor: the book's rainfall graphs of Mumbai on the west coast and Chennai on the east coast
video_script.wrong_answer: both peaks come from the south west monsoon
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko sees that Chennai also gets rain from June, and so gives it the same monsoon as Mumbai.
video_script.payoff_line: mumbai's peak comes from the south west monsoon and chennai's from the north east monsoon

final_answer.value: Mumbai: south west monsoon; Chennai: north east monsoon
final_answer.spoken: mumbai's peak comes from the south west monsoon and chennai's from the north east monsoon

hold_back: Mumbai: south west monsoon; Chennai: north east monsoon
never_show: both peaks come from the south west monsoon
maths_rules: the south west monsoon reaches the west coast from June to September; July is inside this spell
the north east monsoon reaches the south east coast from October to December; November is inside this spell
Mumbai is on the west coast and Chennai on the south east coast
Chennai starts getting rain from June onwards, but its peak is in November
slip: some rain in June does not make June to September the season of the peak

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks both peaks come from the south west monsoon, because Chennai also gets some rain from June.
<bookmark mark='peak'/>But that small rain is not the peak. Chennai's rain peaks in November.
<bookmark mark='ne'/>November is not in the June to September spell. It is in the spell of the north east monsoon.
